info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Promotional Events Management API
info.description: The Promotional Events Management API streamlines the creation and management of marketing promotional events. This API allows businesses to efficiently plan, initiate, and track various promotional activities aimed at enhancing customer engagement and driving sales. Typical consumers include marketing teams and product managers who leverage this API to launch targeted campaigns and promotions. Through a user-friendly interface, users can submit event details, ensuring an organized and effective promotional strategy.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new promotional event within the marketing segment. It accepts necessary details about the event in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new promotional event in the marketing system. It contains the necessary details and parameters required for the event, as specified by the schema.

budget.description: The budget details for the campaign.

startDate.description: The start date of the campaign in ISO 8601 format.
